# Verdant Greenhouse Monitor

A monitoring app for a commercial greenhouse. Sensors in each greenhouse zone report temperature, humidity, CO2 and
soil moisture every minute; cameras over the benches detect pests and send a snapshot with what they saw and how sure
they are. Operators watch a dashboard with the latest readings and the last 24 hours as charts, see which devices are
offline or low on battery, review camera detections and confirm or dismiss them, and acknowledge alerts. Admins add
devices to a zone, set alert rules such as "CO2 above 1200 ppm for 10 minutes" or "pest detected with high
confidence", and can send a device a reboot command.

Look: clean and technical, light background, a leaf green accent.
